query: difference between black soil and laterite soil

payload.answer: Black soil is made of extremely fine clayey material that holds moisture well and is rich in nutrients like calcium carbonate and magnesium, though it lacks phosphoric acid [1]. In contrast, laterite soil develops under tropical climates with heavy rain, resulting from intense leaching that makes it deep, acidic, and generally deficient in plant nutrients [1]. While black soil cracks during hot weather to allow air in, laterite soil is often humus-rich where forests grow but humus-poor in semi-arid areas and is prone to erosion [1].
